issues.description: Dispatched a full coding subagent (~123K tokens) for mem-vault-01 before checking sub-issue states; epic #801's checklist was stale and the work had already shipped as #802 inside PR #812. Agent correctly detected it and made no changes. Lesson: before dispatching from an epic checklist, verify each sub-issue's GitHub state (open/closed) — checklists go stale.

Verification gates executed in-process by the orchestrator (Skill invocation + evidence blocks + CI watch) instead of Tier-3 subagent dispatch. Guard 5 conditions met (announce, evidence artifacts, same-response rule); recorded for visibility, deliberate token-efficiency choice per user directive.

Permission classifier denied gh issue-body edits mid-run (external-system writes) despite upfront user approval; recovered by surfacing to user and re-running after explicit re-authorization. Consider capturing explicit external-mutation consent in the upfront alignment answers so the intent is visible to the classifier.
